import json
import os
import subprocess
import tarfile
import time
from pathlib import Path
from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

started=time.monotonic(); archive=Path('runs/final_replay_isolated_checkout').resolve(); assert not archive.exists()
archive.mkdir(); tar=Path('runs/final_replay.tar')
commit=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
command=['git','archive','--format=tar',f'--output={tar}','HEAD']; subprocess.run(command,check=True)
with tarfile.open(tar) as bundle: bundle.extractall(archive,filter='data')
assert not list(archive.rglob('*.safetensors'))
subprocess.run(['.venv/bin/python','-m','venv',str(archive/'.venv')],check=True)
import numpy
original_site=Path(numpy.__file__).parent.parent
isolated_site=next((archive/'.venv/lib').glob('python*/site-packages'))
for dependency in original_site.glob('numpy*'):
 (isolated_site/dependency.name).symlink_to(dependency,target_is_directory=dependency.is_dir())
env={**os.environ,'PYTHONPATH':str(archive/'src'),'HF_HUB_OFFLINE':'1','TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE':'1'}
for name in ('NVIDIA_API_KEY','KAGGLE_KEY','KAGGLE_API_TOKEN','KAGGLE_TOKEN_FILE'): env.pop(name,None)
loaded=subprocess.check_output(['.venv/bin/python','-c','import makemarket; print(makemarket.__file__)'],cwd=archive,env=env,text=True).strip()
assert Path(loaded).is_relative_to(archive)
run=['.venv/bin/python','scripts/score_frozen_candidates.py']
with Path('runs/final_replay.log').open('w') as log: subprocess.run(run,cwd=archive,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
manifest_path=Path('results/final/summary.json');manifest=json.loads(manifest_path.read_text());checks={}
for label,entry in manifest['results'].items():
 original=json.loads(Path(entry['file']).read_text()); replay=json.loads((archive/entry['file']).read_text())
 assert original['games']==replay['games'] and original['targets']==replay['targets'],label
 checks[label]={'score_file':entry['file'],'score_sha256':file_sha256(entry['file']),'games_and_targets_exact':True,
 'model_revision':original['provenance']['model_revision'],'complete_games':list(original['games'])}
partial=manifest['partial_result']['file'];assert json.loads(Path(partial).read_text())['rows']==json.loads((archive/partial).read_text())['rows']
record={'provenance':receipt({'purpose':'Replay final numeric scores from tracked files without model weights or API credentials'}),
 'source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'status':'PASS','archived_commit':commit,'archive_command':command,'archive_sha256':file_sha256(tar),
 'replay_command':run,'manifest_sha256':file_sha256(manifest_path),'loaded_package':loaded,'private_model_weights_present':False,
 'api_credentials_removed':True,'runtime_isolation':'Fresh Python venv, shared installed NumPy only; no original editable import hooks. Archived src resolves locally.','checks':checks,'partial_dice_rows_exact':True,'wall_seconds':time.monotonic()-started,
 'prior_attempt':{'status':'guard_rejected','reason':'Reusing the editable venv loaded the original checkout despite PYTHONPATH; package-location assertion stopped before scoring. Replaced with fresh venv and shared NumPy only.'},
 'scope':'Same committed episodes and installed arithmetic environment; exact games/targets equality. This is numeric reproduction, not fresh model inference or another test trial.'}
Path('results/final/cached_replay_check.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Exact fresh-checkout replay PASS:',len(checks),'policies and partial dice; no weights/API credentials.')
